name: Playfair Display + Source Sans 3
summary: An elegant serif for headlines over a plain, readable sans. Suits editorial, hospitality and education.
whyItWorks: A high-contrast serif gives personality to headings while a neutral sans keeps long text easy to read. The two contrast in style but not in size.
avoid: Playfair Display for body text or text under 18px.
More than two weights per family.
